title: The Real Ending of Secrets
subtitle: What really happened that night.

captions.facebook:
“My aunt never found my mother in the driveway. There was no moment under the honeysuckle. Their eyes never met.”

The very first story I shared on Not Plain was about the night I was born. I had asked my aunt to tell it to me many times. After I published it, I sent it to her and asked if anything was inaccurate. She called me.

Most of it was how she remembered. The living room, the Christmas tree, the feeling that something was strange. But the ending was different.

My first post for paid subscribers. Subscribe to read it here:
https://sarahnotplain.substack.com/p/the-real-ending-of-secrets
